prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: RuneNexus HIGH-HP UNARMORED TANK enemy concept, character design image only.
Primary request: redesign the attached selected stone guardian as a large-bulk HIGH HEALTH tank with ZERO ARMOR. The reference is for recognizable face, stone material, rune language and studio presentation ONLY; remove every helmet, plate, cuff, cap, hinge mechanism and metal trim in it, and change the body proportions to show health through enormous natural mass. This is NOT just painting armor gray or removing gold while leaving armor-shaped stone plates.

Character identity: same stern but charming stone guardian face, inset glowing turquoise eyes, small straight mouth line, wide soft/chamfered stone head. Head is now around ONE QUARTER overall character height and appreciably narrower than the massive torso. An angular turquoise spiral rune carved directly INTO THE NATURAL BARE STONE FOREHEAD, no separate forehead slab, no raised plate. Retain ONE small warm amber round chest energy core, naturally recessed into a simple stone socket, NO metal ring.

Unarmored tank anatomy: the most salient form is an ENORMOUS broad rounded barrel torso and thick belly, about 1.7 times head width. Torso is one large continuous sculpted boulder volume extending from chest into belly; no layered breastplates, cuirass edges, stacked brickwork, belt or ab segments. A broad thick back and short powerful neck. Thick rounded stone upper arms join naturally into the broad upper torso; shoulders read as actual body volume, NOT separate shoulder caps or spherical pauldrons. Huge blunt heavy forearms and oversized stone fists at hip level, no wrist bands. Very short sturdy chunky thighs and shins, widely planted massive flat stone feet with a few restrained carved toe divisions. Low center of gravity, dense stocky mass and stubborn calm stance. No horns or spikes. Body silhouette noticeably more massive and belly-heavy than the reference; do NOT preserve its small waist and top-heavy gold-shoulder silhouette.
Joints: small recessed dark stone articulation gaps at elbows/knees/hips only; concealed stone articulation, no brass or metallic bearings, no visible robot discs, rivets, pins or mechanisms. Keep them sparse and subtle so bare body reads as a stone creature, not an armored robot.

Surface language: cohesive warm gray-brown weathered stone throughout body, large rounded/chamfered sculpted masses with fine granular stone texture and a few shallow natural cracks; believable weight and broad readable planes. Cracks are irregular hairlines, not full grooves outlining armor panels or layered rock scales. The old helmet/shoulder/forearm armor shapes are completely GONE. Only turquoise eyes/forehead rune and the small amber chest core provide color accents. Contained soft emission, no aura. NO GOLD, BRASS, METAL, CLOTHING, SHELL, ARMOR OR SHIELD ANYWHERE.

Composition: one clean square polished stylized 3D concept plate. Dominant full-body three-quarter front view angled toward the lower-left, entirely uncropped with clear margins and ground contact, relaxed arms lowered and fists closed, feet planted slightly apart. Add one SMALL consistent high-angle overhead inset at upper-right of EXACT SAME BARE STONE giant, showing enormous broad stone torso/back and heavy limbs and NO armor. Plain desaturated dark navy-gray studio background, soft well-lit studio key and fill with natural shading, restrained ground shadow, no pedestal, scenery, HUD, health bars, title, text, number, logos, watermark, enemies, weapons, floating bits or decorative particles.
Match the original's polished sculpted stylized 3D game quality and natural stone texture. Prioritize a clear readable difference between 'large health reserve from body mass' and 'protection from equipped armor'.
